title: Navy SEAL finds a black octagonal structure near McMurdo

tellings.quote: highly polished black stone octagonal structure sticking out like 18 ft above the ice.

plain: A Navy SEAL, a US special forces sailor, is said to have found a "highly polished black stone octagonal structure" standing about 18 feet out of the ice near McMurdo, the main US research station in Antarctica. The philosopher Jason Jorjani passes this on from the researcher Linda Moulton Howe, who told the story. If true, something built by someone would be sitting under the Antarctic ice.
